subject: Renewal: Hosted API capacity increase and tiered rate corridor
content:
-----Original Message-----
From: Emma Park <emma.park@luminar.ai>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal planning & capacity increase

Hi Jasmine,

Quick note as we approach the June renewal window — the product team wants to secure a higher committed throughput for our hosted API plan. Q1 usage spiked as we rolled out the new summarization feature and forecasts show another 2.5x increase for Q3.

Key asks:
- Increase monthly committed tokens from current 500M to 1.25B starting 2027-07-01.
- Keep a soft-burst option (2x) for peak days but tighten the overage rate compared to last year.
- Prefer a 12-month term but are open to a 9-month ramp if that helps pricing.

Can you send a proposed amendment and high-level cost impact? We will need this to start our procurement review.

Thanks,
Emma
Emma Park
Head of NLP Product, Luminar.ai
——
Luminar.ai | emma.park@luminar.ai


-----Reply (internal)-----
From: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal planning & capacity increase

Looping in Karthik and Vanessa — Luminar is asking for a sizable bump and wants to lock to July 1. They prefer 12 months but could do 9-month ramp. Attached Q1 usage.

Immediate asks for ops/legal/pricing:
- Karthik: confirm if 1.25B/month is feasible on their Dedicated fallback and what latency profile we can promise under the new commit.
- Vanessa: need a pricing sketch (committed vs overage) and a suggested soft-burst policy (2x, how to charge).
- Marissa: can you start procurement playbook / mutual action plan — likely will need PO and updated MPA.

Id like to propose a 12-month MPA with a stepped discount: higher commit -> lower per-token price, and a fixed burst pocket (daily cap) that auto-depletes.

-Jasmine
Account Executive | Redwood Inference


-----Internal response (Karthik)-----
From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 17:12:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: Renewal planning & capacity increase

Short answer: feasible. A few notes from infra/ops perspective:

- 1.25B tokens/month is within expected utilization for a single enterprise tenant on hosted pools, but we should clarify their QPS distribution (spiky vs steady).
- For spikes, we can offer a controlled burst pocket at 2x daily peak with a daily cap (e.g., 30% of monthly commit per day) to avoid noisy-neighbor risk.
- Latency: under steady-state commit we can keep p95 generation latency within current SLOs (sub-600ms for median prompt mix). During burst consumption we recommend routing to a higher-cost fast-path (additional per-token multiplier).

Operational asks:
1) Confirm whether Luminar will accept a two-tiered overage model: a discounted overage to 150% of base rate up to the burst pocket, then full overage rate beyond that.
2) If they want the 9-month ramp, we'll need to pro-rate onboarding credits and set a mid-term usage review.

I can prepare an ops appendix for the MPA.
-Karthik
VP, Infrastructure | Redwood Inference


-----Internal response (Vanessa)-----
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: Renewal planning & capacity increase

Pricing sketch attached (high-level):
- Option A (12-month): 1.25B/mo commit, $0.0009 per token (committed rate), burst pocket priced at $0.0012/token up to 30% monthly cap per day, overage beyond burst at $0.0018/token.
- Option B (9-month ramp): Start 750M/mo for 3 months -> 1.25B/mo rest of term. Committed rate $0.0010/token, burst $0.00135/token, overage $0.0020/token.

Discount note: we can offer a one-time onboarding credit equal to one week of expected commit if they sign before June 1.

Marissa — include these options in MAP and confirm if procurement needs a Net30 or Net45 PO timeline.

-Vanessa
Senior Sales Ops Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: Luminar_MonthlyUsage_Q1-2027.csv (usage broken down by day), Pricing_Sketch_Luminar.xlsx (summary)
